sessionId.description: Session.ConversationId: one bot conversation per call

text.description: What the caller said; empty on the first turn (the bot greets)

ani.description: Call.Ani: the caller's number. A registered phone needs only the last 4 ID digits

handoffReason.description: Why the bot hands over, e.g. loan_close, agent, verify_failed

verifiedPhone.description: Registered phone of the verified customer, +66 format (e.g. +66810000002); empty = not verified

expectsDigits.description: true while the bot waits for a number

requestDetail.description: What the customer wants, e.g. ปิดบัญชีสินเชื่อบ้าน (สอบถามรายละเอียดก่อน)

ticket.description: Case number talked about (the customer's own), e.g. CS0001001

loanDetail.description: The loan a loan request is about, e.g. สินเชื่อบ้าน ลงท้าย 4567 คงเหลือ 2,350,000 บาท ดอกเบี้ย 5.25% ...

closeReason.description: Why the customer closes the loan, e.g. รีไฟแนนซ์ไปธนาคารอื่น (กสิกรไทย)

summary.description: One line for the agent, at most 500 characters

transcript.description: End of the conversation, at most 500 characters

topic.description: ServiceNow: payoff | homeloan_inquiry | credit_card | deposit | complaint | other

identify_type.description: ServiceNow: national_id when verified, else empty

loan_number.description: ServiceNow: the loan the request is about, e.g. PHL-LN-0002

reason.description: ServiceNow: why the customer closes the loan: refinance | own_funds | sell_property | high_installment | high_interest | not_given | other

closing_within_days.description: ServiceNow: days until the customer must close, e.g. 30

new_bank_name.description: ServiceNow: the bank the customer moves to, e.g. ธนาคาร B

new_interest_rate.description: ServiceNow: rate the new bank offers, % a year, e.g. 3.25

promotion_period_months.description: ServiceNow: the new bank's promotion period in months, e.g. 24

cashback_offered.description: ServiceNow: cash back the new bank offers, baht, e.g. 5000
